country.evidence_quote: Based in Malta, Mark Borg is an award-winning goldsmith, silversmith and filigree artist whose journey began at the age of 13, when he attended his first filigree course. Since then, he has developed a distinctive approach that combines the precision and heritage of traditional Maltese filigree with contemporary ideas, materials and techniques.
